# State Class View (variant): Conservation corps member (local)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> All task importance, time share, critical, needed-at-entry and target-level values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Credential gates and sign-off are shown only as drafts until an E-labelled source is attached.

- **Role:** Conservation corps member (`seed:R01-conservation-corps-member`, P1); authority position (editorial): service-provider
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Implement ecological restoration treatments and adapt them to site response — entry L1
- Construct and maintain trails to sustainable design standards — entry L1
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — entry L1
- Use and maintain hand tools safely for field work — entry L1
- Operate chainsaws and other power equipment safely in field conditions — entry L1
- Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids — entry L1
- Detect, treat and monitor invasive species in the field — entry L1
- Install and maintain erosion control and watershed treatments — entry L1
- Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings — entry L1
- Communicate during field emergencies and report incidents — entry L1
